Goal:

The goal of this program is a simple game of hangman. You'll need at least five predetermined words to randomly pick from when the game starts. You should give the user up to six seven guesses. You'll need checks to see of the user's input is a letter, is one character, and if it matches any of the letters in the chosen word. When a correct letter is picked display the letter(s) on the screen in a way that will show the user where in the word the letters are.

Bonus:

Draw a little hanging man in ASCII that gets more hung as the user fails with his or her guesses.

Note:

Make sure to include what version of python you are running.
